title: Order bread for pickup in three screens
body:
### Summary

As a customer of the bakery, I want to order bread for pickup in three screens and know the order went through, so that ordering feels quick and trustworthy.

### Completion Goal

1. [recording] state: `/order` as the seeded customer with an empty basket; expected: choosing one loaf, a pickup time, and paying takes at most 3 screens, after which the order confirmation shows
2. [screenshot] state: the order confirmation after the seeded customer pays; expected: a screen of its own with the order number and the chosen pickup time
3. [screenshot] state: `/order/review` with the seeded basket of 2 items; expected: the total price and the pickup time are shown on the review screen before paying
4. [recording] state: `/order/review` when the seeded customer pays with the seeded declining test card; expected: an error message and a "Try again" button appear on the same screen and the basket still holds its 2 items
5. [screenshot] state: each of the 3 order screens at 390 px and 1280 px wide; expected: the screen shows without horizontal scrolling at both widths
6. [metric] state: the changed files of the 3 order screens; expected: 0 colour, spacing, or font values outside the `--crumb-` tokens in `web/styles/tokens.css`, and 0 components besides the existing ones in `web/components`

### Measure

Completion Goal criteria observed

### Threshold

all 6 criteria

### Scenario

As the seeded customer, open /order with an empty basket, choose one loaf, choose a pickup time and enter details on the second screen, review and pay on the third, and see the confirmation; repeat with the seeded declining test card; capture each screen at 390 px and 1280 px.

### Environment

local app with the seeded synthetic customer and the payment stub; never production

### Links

depends-on #14

### Assumptions

- Payment stays as it is today (lib/payments.ts); the seeded declining test card makes a payment fail.
- The order confirmation is a new screen; its order number comes from POST /api/orders.
- The pickup slots come from #14.

### Open questions

- answered: which task first (a first order for pickup, ending on a confirmation)
- answered: where the confirmation goes (its own screen after paying, not one of the three)
- deferred: the exact wording of the confirmation and the payment error message (the human writes it with the shop staff; the build uses placeholders they review)
- deferred: offline handling (the human says it can wait)

### Parked ideas

- loyalty stamp card: every tenth loaf free, shown on the confirmation (raised by grill; the human parked it)

### Provenance

Request: "The bakery app needs high-quality UX for ordering. It belongs under Feature #40 (Online ordering)."
Vague: "high-quality UX" → criteria 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
1. confirmed (ux.steps/screen-count): "Three screens at most"; facts: flow:/order
2. confirmed (ux.steps/confirmation-placement): "The confirmation is its own screen after paying" / "they see an order number and the pickup time"; facts: route:/api/orders, event:order_submitted
3. stated (ux.trust/before-paying): "Show the total price and the pickup time on the review screen before they pay"; facts: route:/order/review, component:BasketSummary
4. confirmed (ux.states/payment-failure): "keep the basket and show a message with a Try again button on the same screen"; facts: gap:error:/order, event:payment_declined
5. default (ux.platforms/widths): "Your default is fine."; facts: floor:platforms
6. confirmed (ux.consistency/tokens-and-components): "Only our existing tokens and components"; facts: tokens:web/styles/tokens.css, component:Button, component:Stepper
